sql: SELECT item_id, vendor_id, vendor_name, amount_usd, CAST(scheduled_date AS STRING) AS scheduled_date, CAST(bank_changed_at AS STRING) AS bank_changed_at, datediff(CAST(scheduled_date AS DATE), CAST(bank_changed_at AS DATE)) AS days_before, callback_phone_source FROM lightning.metastore.probity.vendor360.payment_run_item WHERE bank_changed_at IS NOT NULL AND scheduled_date IS NOT NULL AND datediff(CAST(scheduled_date AS DATE), CAST(bank_changed_at AS DATE)) BETWEEN 0 AND 14 LIMIT 50
